summary: The candidate updates the rollback test to exercise the current owner-gated park path by filling the review receipt to MaxItems.findings, which prevents the acceptance finding from being appended; the stored receipt remains parseable under R80 and the seeded record stays idle. The base test expected round-count parking that the source intentionally retired, so the changed test targets the stale assertion.

evidence: tests/repair/acceptance-rollback-r80_test.ts lines 82-103 replace the review observation findings with exactly MaxItems.findings, forcing withAcceptanceFinding to return null at the full-receipt bound.

tests/repair/acceptance-rollback-r80_test.ts lines 313-337 assert that the stored receipt is full, carries TASK_ACCEPTANCE_OWNER_GATE_DETAIL, parses under R80, and yields idle without model or review requests.

The base test called gen81State with three rounds and expected the owner-gated park, but src/repair/loop-review-result.ts lines 355-375 only park when withAcceptanceFinding cannot add the normalized finding, so the candidate fixes the stale expectation that failed test-shards.
